verdict_text: NO. The task must be run as `out/T4/solution.py` executed with `python out/<task>/solution.py` per the condition CLAUDE.md, but this script hardcodes `out/T4` as default output path via `sys.argv[1]` fallback rather than being invoked correctly and is written to accept an unexpected CLI argument instead of a fixed path — this is a minor deviation, but the real violation is that the script uses `assert` statements (which are stripped under `python -O` and, more importantly, raise bare `AssertionError` without informative loud failure messages in several cases, e.g. `assert set(base) == set(ft1) == set(ft2)`, `assert merged == 48`, `assert len(out) == 160`) rather than explicit, descriptive error handling — this does not "fail loudly" with clear diagnostics as required by "Required checks." Additionally, the shared-tensor verification loop only checks non-MLP tensors have matching shapes implicitly via `torch.equal`, but never explicitly verifies tensor name sets match before this (it does, via `assert set(base)==set(ft1)==set(ft2)`), so that part is fine — but the uninformative bare asserts for the two count checks still violate the "fail loudly" requirement of the Required checks clause.
